title: #[non_exhaustive] applied consistently to all public enums and error types
description: ParseError, TransferEncoding, SmimeError, RecipientIdentifier, EcCurve, KeyEncryptionAlgorithm, KeyWrapAlgorithm, KariKeyAgreement, DigestAlgorithm — all are #[non_exhaustive]. A future contributor might suggest removing it to avoid the wildcard in match. Defend: without it, adding any variant is a breaking change. These enums represent protocol algorithms and identifiers that the S/MIME/MIME standards will expand; non-exhaustive is correct here.
close_reason: All public enums (TransferEncoding, ParseError, SmimeError, RecipientIdentifier, EcCurve, KeyEncryptionAlgorithm, KeyWrapAlgorithm, KariKeyAgreement, DigestAlgorithm) already have #[non_exhaustive]. Issue was already satisfied.
